summary: The filing reports a continuous private offering of new series of shares and amendments to management and operating agreements. The company is redesignating existing shares and creating three new series with higher minimum investments, different fees, and additional restrictions. There is no transaction involving a change of control, acquisition, or liquidation. This is a routine capital-raising and governance update with no M&A or restructuring catalyst. What to watch: any subscription levels from accredited investors under Rule 506(b).
